name: Socratism
notAnIdeology: English Wikipedia has no article on Socratism: the name redirects to the 'Socratic' disambiguation page, which lists only the Socratic method, questioning and unrelated items, none of them a political ideology. Socrates left no political programme of his own (the SEP describes him as aligned with neither democrats nor oligarchs), so it is a person's philosophical approach, with its political implications covered under Platonism.
